candidates.locator: Page: 3, Section: part_i, Outfalls 001 authorization paragraph
candidates.exact_span: During the period beginning the effective date of the permit and lasting through the dismantle of Outfall 001, the permittee is authorized to discharge storm runoffs from storage and production areas, once-through cooling water, cleaning water, and Artesian well water from Outfalls 001.
candidates.computation_change_reason: The start and end boundaries of authorization, and which discharge types are authorized, determine whether limits and monitoring obligations apply during Federal FY2025 and whether a given discharge event falls within permitted scope versus a no-discharge or out-of-scope period.

candidates.locator: Page: 3, Section: part_i, Outfalls 001 authorization paragraph
candidates.exact_span: Such discharges shall be limited and monitored by the permittee as specified below (1):
candidates.computation_change_reason: This ties operative limits and monitoring requirements to the table below and to footnote (1); a different reading of what is 'specified below' or what footnote (1) adds could change which limits are enforceable and which monitoring duties attach.

candidates.locator: Page: 3, Section: part_i, Outfalls 001 limits table, pH row
candidates.computation_change_reason: Numeric minimum and maximum pH values establish enforceable discharge limits for compliance comparison, and the 1/Day Grab monitoring specification establishes a monitoring obligation whose applicability and fulfillment must be evaluated.
